name: Kolkata
overview: Capital of West Bengal and the main international gateway to eastern India, known for its colonial architecture, literature, food and festivals such as Durga Puja.
airport: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport (CCU)
rail: Howrah Junction and Sealdah stations, plus the Kolkata Metro

name: Darjeeling
overview: Himalayan hill station known for tea gardens, views of Kanchenjunga and the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
airport: Bagdogra Airport (IXB), then about 3 to 4 hours by road
rail: New Jalpaiguri (NJP) or Siliguri Junction, then road or the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway

name: Kalimpong
overview: Quieter hill town in the Darjeeling district with monasteries, orchid nurseries and mountain views.

name: Sandakphu and Singalila National Park
overview: High-altitude trek along the Singalila ridge on the border with Nepal and Sikkim, with views of Everest and Kanchenjunga on clear days.
rail: New Jalpaiguri (NJP), then road to Manebhanjan
permit: The trek passes through Singalila National Park, which has entry rules and fees. Foreign visitors should confirm current requirements, including guide rules and the Nepal border area, with the West Bengal Forest Department before travel.

name: Sundarbans
overview: The world's largest mangrove forest, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and tiger reserve, reached by boat from the delta region south of Kolkata.
airport: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport (CCU), then road and boat
rail: Canning station, then road and boat
permit: Entry to the Sundarban Tiger Reserve needs a permit from the forest authorities, and foreign visitors may be charged different fees. Book through an authorised operator and confirm current rules with the West Bengal Forest Department.

name: Siliguri
overview: Major transit hub in North Bengal for onward travel to Darjeeling, Kalimpong, Sikkim, Bhutan and the Dooars.

name: Shantiniketan
overview: Town in Birbhum associated with Rabindranath Tagore and Visva-Bharati University. Shantiniketan was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2023.
airport: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport (CCU), about 3 hours by road

name: Bishnupur
overview: Town in Bankura district known for its terracotta temples, Baluchari saris and classical music tradition.
airport: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport (CCU), then train or road

name: Murshidabad
overview: Former capital of Bengal under the Nawabs, with palaces, mosques and the Hazarduari Palace.
airport: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport (CCU), then train or road

name: Digha
overview: Popular seaside resort on the Bay of Bengal, mainly visited by domestic travelers for short breaks.
airport: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport (CCU), then train or road

name: Cooch Behar
overview: Former princely state in North Bengal, known for the Cooch Behar Palace.
airport: Cooch Behar Airport has limited service. Bagdogra (IXB) is the main alternative.
rail: Cooch Behar and New Cooch Behar stations

name: Dooars and Jaldapara
overview: Forested foothills in North Bengal with tea estates and wildlife reserves such as Jaldapara and Gorumara National Parks.
rail: New Jalpaiguri (NJP), Hasimara, New Mal and Alipurduar stations
permit: National parks have entry rules and fees, and some close during the monsoon. Confirm current rules with the West Bengal Forest Department.
